facts.fact: L'Economiste Maghrebin reports RNE director general Adel Chouari saying the RNE has digitised company creation (individuals, SARL, SA) and online filing of financial statements, which more than 65,000 firms use.
The article says the RNE assigns the unique identifier required for all administrative and tax procedures, under law 2018-52 of 29 October 2018.
